+"""Persistence and validation for Best Book Award nominations."""
+
+from sqlite3 import IntegrityError
+
+from psycopg2.errors import UniqueViolation
+
+from . import db
+from .bookshelves import Bookshelves
+
+
+class Bestbook(db.CommonExtras):
+    TABLENAME = "bestbook"
+    PRIMARY_KEY = ("username", "work_id")
+    ALLOW_DELETE_ON_CONFLICT = True
+
+    class AwardConditionsError(ValueError):
+        pass
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_awards(cls, work_id=None, username=None, topic=None):
+        filters = {"work_id": work_id, "username": username, "topic": topic}
+        filters = {key: int(value) if key == "work_id" else value for key, value in filters.items() if value is not None}
+        where = " AND ".join(f"{key}=${key}" for key in filters) or "1=1"
+        return list(db.get_db().select(cls.TABLENAME, where=where, vars=filters))
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_count(cls, work_id=None, username=None, topic=None):
+        filters = {"work_id": work_id, "username": username, "topic": topic}
+        filters = {key: int(value) if key == "work_id" else value for key, value in filters.items() if value is not None}
+        where = " WHERE " + " AND ".join(f"{key}=${key}" for key in filters) if filters else ""
+        result = db.get_db().query(f"SELECT count(*) AS count FROM {cls.TABLENAME}{where}", vars=filters)
+        return result[0].count
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_leaderboard(cls):
+        query = f"SELECT work_id, count(*) AS count FROM {cls.TABLENAME} GROUP BY work_id ORDER BY count DESC, work_id"
+        return [dict(row) for row in db.get_db().query(query)]
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate(cls, username, work_id, topic, existing=None):
+        if not topic or not isinstance(topic, str) or not topic.strip():
+            raise cls.AwardConditionsError("A topic is required")
+        if not Bookshelves.user_has_read_work(username, work_id):
+            raise cls.AwardConditionsError("Only books which have been marked as read may be given awards")
+        for award in cls.get_awards(username=username):
+            if existing is not None and award.id == existing.id:
+                continue
+            if award.work_id == int(work_id):
+                raise cls.AwardConditionsError("You have already awarded this book")
+            if award.topic == topic:
+                raise cls.AwardConditionsError("You have already awarded a book for this topic")
+
+    @classmethod
+    def add(cls, username, work_id, topic, comment="", edition_id=None):
+        cls._validate(username, work_id, topic)
+        try:
+            return db.get_db().insert(cls.TABLENAME, username=username, work_id=int(work_id), topic=topic, comment=comment or "", edition_id=edition_id)
+        except (UniqueViolation, IntegrityError) as exc:
+            raise cls.AwardConditionsError("You have already awarded this book or topic") from exc
+
+    @classmethod
+    def update(cls, username, work_id, topic, comment="", edition_id=None):
+        existing = cls.get_awards(username=username, work_id=work_id)
+        if not existing:
+            raise cls.AwardConditionsError("No award exists for this book")
+        cls._validate(username, work_id, topic, existing=existing[0])
+        try:
+            db.get_db().update(cls.TABLENAME, where="id=$id", vars={"id": existing[0].id}, topic=topic, comment=comment or "", edition_id=edition_id)
+        except (UniqueViolation, IntegrityError) as exc:
+            raise cls.AwardConditionsError("You have already awarded this book or topic") from exc
+        return existing[0].id
+
+    @classmethod
+    def remove(cls, username, work_id=None, topic=None):
+        if work_id is None and topic is None:
+            raise cls.AwardConditionsError("A work or topic is required")
+        filters = {"username": username}
+        if work_id is not None:
+            filters["work_id"] = int(work_id)
+        if topic is not None:
+            filters["topic"] = topic
+        where = " AND ".join(f"{key}=${key}" for key in filters)
+        return db.get_db().delete(cls.TABLENAME, where=where, vars=filters)

+import pytest
+import web
+
+from openlibrary.core import db
+from openlibrary.core.bestbook import Bestbook
+from openlibrary.core.bookshelves import Bookshelves
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def awards_db(monkeypatch):
+    database = web.database(dbn="sqlite", db=":memory:")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(db, "get_db", lambda: database)
+    database.query("""CREATE TABLE bestbook (
+        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, username text NOT NULL, work_id integer NOT NULL,
+        topic text NOT NULL, comment text NOT NULL, edition_id integer,
+        UNIQUE(username, work_id), UNIQUE(username, topic))""")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(Bookshelves, "user_has_read_work", lambda user, work: work != "3")
+    return database
+
+
+def test_award_lifecycle_and_constraints(awards_db):
+    award_id = Bestbook.add("reader", "1", "fiction", "Great", 5)
+    assert award_id == 1
+    assert Bestbook.get_count(work_id="1") == 1
+    assert Bestbook.get_count(username="reader", topic="fiction") == 1
+    assert Bestbook.get_awards(work_id="1")[0].comment == "Great"
+    with pytest.raises(Bestbook.AwardConditionsError, match="already awarded this book"):
+        Bestbook.add("reader", "1", "history")
+    with pytest.raises(Bestbook.AwardConditionsError, match="already awarded a book for this topic"):
+        Bestbook.add("reader", "2", "fiction")
+    with pytest.raises(Bestbook.AwardConditionsError, match="Only books which have been marked as read"):
+        Bestbook.add("reader", "3", "history")
+    assert Bestbook.update("reader", "1", "classics") == award_id
+    assert Bestbook.get_count(topic="fiction") == 0
+    assert Bestbook.get_leaderboard() == [{"work_id": 1, "count": 1}]
+    assert Bestbook.remove("reader", work_id="1") == 1
+    assert Bestbook.get_count() == 0
+
+
+def test_award_redirect_and_anonymization(awards_db):
+    Bestbook.add("reader", "1", "fiction")
+    Bestbook.add("other", "2", "fiction")
+    assert Bestbook.update_work_id("1", "2")["rows_changed"] == 1
+    assert Bestbook.update_username("reader", "anonymous") == 1
+    assert Bestbook.get_count(work_id="2", username="anonymous") == 1
+
+
+def test_award_api(awards_db, monkeypatch):
+    import json
+
+    from openlibrary import accounts
+    from openlibrary.plugins.openlibrary.api import bestbook_award, bestbook_count
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(accounts, "get_current_user", lambda: web.storage(key="/users/reader"))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, "input", lambda **kwargs: web.storage(kwargs))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, "data", lambda: b'{"op":"add","topic":"fiction"}')
+    web.ctx.env = {"CONTENT_TYPE": "application/json"}
+    assert json.loads(bestbook_award.POST.__wrapped__(None, "1")) == {"success": True, "award": 1}
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, "data", lambda: b'{"op":"update","topic":"classics"}')
+    assert json.loads(bestbook_award.POST.__wrapped__(None, "1")) == {"success": True, "award": 1}
+    assert Bestbook.get_count(topic="classics") == 1
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, "data", lambda: b'{"op":"update","topic":"fiction"}')
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, "input", lambda **kwargs: web.storage(dict(kwargs, work_id="1", username="reader", topic="classics")))
+    assert json.loads(bestbook_count.GET.__wrapped__(None)) == {"count": 1}
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, "data", lambda: b'{"op":"remove"}')
+    assert json.loads(bestbook_award.POST.__wrapped__(None, "1")) == {"success": True, "rows": 1}
+    assert Bestbook.get_count() == 0
+    monkeypatch.setattr(accounts, "get_current_user", lambda: None)
+    assert json.loads(bestbook_award.POST.__wrapped__(None, "1")) == {"errors": "Authentication failed"}

+            filters["work_id"] = int(work_id)

+            filters["topic"] = topic

+        return db.get_db().delete(cls.TABLENAME, where=where, vars=filters)

@@ -0,0 +1,69 @@
+import pytest
+import web
+
+from openlibrary.core import db
+from openlibrary.core.bestbook import Bestbook
+from openlibrary.core.bookshelves import Bookshelves
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def awards_db(monkeypatch):
+    database = web.database(dbn="sqlite", db=":memory:")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(db, "get_db", lambda: database)
+    database.query("""CREATE TABLE bestbook (
+        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, username text NOT NULL, work_id integer NOT NULL,
+        topic text NOT NULL, comment text NOT NULL, edition_id integer,
+        UNIQUE(username, work_id), UNIQUE(username, topic))""")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(Bookshelves, "user_has_read_work", lambda user, work: work != "3")
+    return database
+
+
+def test_award_lifecycle_and_constraints(awards_db):
+    award_id = Bestbook.add("reader", "1", "fiction", "Great", 5)
+    assert award_id == 1
+    assert Bestbook.get_count(work_id="1") == 1
+    assert Bestbook.get_count(username="reader", topic="fiction") == 1
+    assert Bestbook.get_awards(work_id="1")[0].comment == "Great"
+    with pytest.raises(Bestbook.AwardConditionsError, match="already awarded this book"):
+        Bestbook.add("reader", "1", "history")
+    with pytest.raises(Bestbook.AwardConditionsError, match="already awarded a book for this topic"):
+        Bestbook.add("reader", "2", "fiction")
+    with pytest.raises(Bestbook.AwardConditionsError, match="Only books which have been marked as read"):
+        Bestbook.add("reader", "3", "history")
+    assert Bestbook.update("reader", "1", "classics") == award_id
+    assert Bestbook.get_count(topic="fiction") == 0
+    assert Bestbook.get_leaderboard() == [{"work_id": 1, "count": 1}]
+    assert Bestbook.remove("reader", work_id="1") == 1
+    assert Bestbook.get_count() == 0
+
+
+def test_award_redirect_and_anonymization(awards_db):
+    Bestbook.add("reader", "1", "fiction")
+    Bestbook.add("other", "2", "fiction")
+    assert Bestbook.update_work_id("1", "2")["rows_changed"] == 1
+    assert Bestbook.update_username("reader", "anonymous") == 1
+    assert Bestbook.get_count(work_id="2", username="anonymous") == 1
+
+
+def test_award_api(awards_db, monkeypatch):
+    import json
+
+    from openlibrary import accounts
+    from openlibrary.plugins.openlibrary.api import bestbook_award, bestbook_count
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(accounts, "get_current_user", lambda: web.storage(key="/users/reader"))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, "input", lambda **kwargs: web.storage(kwargs))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, "data", lambda: b'{"op":"add","topic":"fiction"}')
+    web.ctx.env = {"CONTENT_TYPE": "application/json"}
+    assert json.loads(bestbook_award.POST.__wrapped__(None, "1")) == {"success": True, "award": 1}
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, "data", lambda: b'{"op":"update","topic":"classics"}')
+    assert json.loads(bestbook_award.POST.__wrapped__(None, "1")) == {"success": True, "award": 1}
+    assert Bestbook.get_count(topic="classics") == 1
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, "data", lambda: b'{"op":"update","topic":"fiction"}')
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, "input", lambda **kwargs: web.storage(dict(kwargs, work_id="1", username="reader", topic="classics")))
+    assert json.loads(bestbook_count.GET.__wrapped__(None)) == {"count": 1}
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, "data", lambda: b'{"op":"remove"}')
+    assert json.loads(bestbook_award.POST.__wrapped__(None, "1")) == {"success": True, "rows": 1}
+    assert Bestbook.get_count() == 0
+    monkeypatch.setattr(accounts, "get_current_user", lambda: None)
+    assert json.loads(bestbook_award.POST.__wrapped__(None, "1")) == {"errors": "Authentication failed"}
